strict_comparison: Only known prefix bits > threshold prune. Equality reaches the next scorer and may retain smaller-tree ties.
publication: evaluate returns a full total after the last tree, even above threshold. The caller publishes map scores only after a non-null complete result. Individual successful tree scores remain valid cache entries.
eligible_threshold: requested_tree_count <=16 uses max(full_threshold,bounded_threshold); requested_tree_count >16 updates only the full slot under the current policy, even if compaction leaves <=16 actual trees.
numeric_precondition: Unchecked u64 addition requires representable total. The current bounded byte-histogram caller satisfies it; the generic function does not protect arbitrary overflowing u64 costs.
failure_scope: Reached scorer errors propagate. The helper intentionally skips errors of remaining provably irrelevant trees. The current tree scorer has no heap allocation; allocations before the loop still propagate normally.
profile_invariant: The old tree_scored >= 2*(map_cache_misses-map_lower_bound_pruned) must exclude partial-score-pruned maps. Complete map publication remains separate from partially scored tree cache entries.
scope: Temporary candidate source read-only. Standalone module tests only; no caller profiling or library-wide gate.
